data.narrative:
Alto Neuroscience, a publicly traded biotech company founded by Amit Etkin, is valued at $1.04B following $253M in total capital raised. The valuation assessment draws from a peer universe of 5 same-sector, similar-valuation-tier comparables in Biotech & Health, spanning both public and private stages.

The peer-median method is the primary applicable triangulation approach. The five comparables—Chai Discovery ($3.8B Series C), New Limit ($3.1B Series C), Recursion Pharmaceuticals ($1.6B public), Freenome ($1.1B public), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M Series B)—yield a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range from $539M to $3.8B. This method directly anchors the analysis given the homogeneity of the peer set. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples cannot be applied: while the Biotech & Health sector median P/S across three public tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) is 9.2x, Alto's revenue is not on file, precluding meaningful multiple application.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.4B (low) to $1.8B (high), centered on $1.6B. This range sits modestly above Alto's current $1.04B public valuation, reflecting peer benchmarking. Key uncertainties include stage-mixing effects within the peer set—two comparables remain in Series C—and the absence of revenue-based validation. The analysis relies on a single applicable method, limiting confidence beyond the peer median.
